gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically diagnosed glioblastoma patients who have been confirmed the progression of disease after attempting standard therapy

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of GX-I7 in combination with bevacizumab in subjects with recurrent glioblastoma.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Absolute counts and ratios of immune cell subtypes: Changes of absolute counts and ratios of immune cell subtypes

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] GX-I7 and bevacizumab: Bevacizumab at a dose of 10 mg/kg intravenously, and GX-I7 intramuscularly.

agents.drug_class_hint: long-acting recombinant human interleukin-7 (rhIL-7-hyFc), immunomodulatory cytokine

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Bevacizumab (other names: Avastin): Administered by intravenous (IV) injection

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF antibody, established recurrent GBM therapy

coder_notes: Single-arm; bevacizumab at standard 10 mg/kg is the background established GBM therapy (no dose/schedule question), so soc_backbone; GX-I7 is the only investigational agent. Immune cell count changes are a pharmacodynamic endpoint for the IL-7 agent.
